profile.name: Victor Njoroge
profile.title: PhD Software Engineer
profile.subtitle: Backend Systems & AI Evaluation Specialist
profile.openTo: Open to AI evaluation, annotation, full-stack engineering, and technical documentation engagements
profile.summary: PhD-trained software engineer and AI evaluation specialist with over eight years of combined experience spanning three interlocking spheres: end-to-end AI data annotation and large language model evaluation, senior backend software engineering, and technical specification authorship for frontier AI training pipelines.
summaryLong: Deep, hands-on expertise across reinforcement learning from human feedback, supervised fine-tuning, direct preference optimization, reward modelling, chain-of-thought evaluation, code hallucination detection, multimodal and vision-language evaluation, red-team and adversarial testing, and PII and bias auditing.

Complemented by production backend engineering at Standard Chartered Bank, where structured data schema design, API contracts, and observability practices directly underpin current work on annotation infrastructure, JSON and JSONL validation, and rigorous evaluation rubrics.

Most recently leading documentation and specification authorship, producing canonical engineering reference artifacts including incident reports, system design documents, RFCs, API specifications, runbooks, and sprint planning artifacts used as training and evaluation references for large language models.

skills.name: LLM Evaluation & RLHF
skills.detail: End-to-end RLHF and RLAIF workflows; preference ranking and reward signal generation using Likert-scale and pairwise comparison frameworks; Constitutional AI alignment assessment; rubric-based scoring for correctness, safety, helpfulness and harmlessness.

skills.detail: Authoring high-quality SFT prompt-and-response pairs, instruction-tuning datasets, multi-turn dialogue scripts, chain-of-thought demonstrations and scratchpad reasoning traces; expert adversarial and edge-case prompt design.

skills.name: Advanced Alignment: DPO · PPO · GRPO
skills.detail: Hands-on application of Direct Preference Optimization, Proximal Policy Optimization, Group Relative Policy Optimization, reward modelling, self-play data generation, synthetic data creation and data flywheel pipeline contribution.

skills.name: Tool Use & Function Calling Evaluation
skills.detail: Structured evaluation of LLM tool-use and function-calling; assessing correctness of API selection, parameter generation, multi-step tool chaining and error recovery across Python, REST API and database scenarios.

skills.name: Multimodal & Vision-Language Evaluation

skills.name: Red-Team & Adversarial Evaluation

skills.name: Multilingual Annotation — English & Swahili

experience.summary: Contract documentation specialist producing canonical software engineering reference artifacts for large language model training and evaluation pipelines.

highlights.title: Technical Specification Authorship
highlights.text: Authored seven or more detailed technical specifications across software engineering artifact categories including incident reports, system design documents, RFCs, API specifications, bug triage trackers, runbooks and sprint planning artifacts; outputs used directly as training and evaluation references for large language models.

highlights.title: Canonical Source Curation
highlights.text: Sourced, cleaned and submitted eleven or more canonical engineering documents from authoritative public sources, covering incident reports, release runbooks, security references and design collaboration documents.

highlights.title: Document Preparation Pipeline
highlights.text: Built a repeatable document-preparation pipeline including canonical source extraction, structural cleanup at the OOXML and docx XML layer, hyperlink and chrome stripping, and image preservation; reduced per-document preparation time significantly through standardized templates and reusable cleanup scripts.

highlights.title: Reviewer Calibration
highlights.text: Calibrated work against multiple reviewers across iterative cycles, meeting standards for structure, specificity, formatting and self-containment; incorporated feedback rapidly to maintain high acceptance rates on submitted documents.

experience.summary: Lead evaluator and RLHF specialist delivering PhD-level software engineering expertise across LLM training, alignment and evaluation projects covering code assessment, multimodal tasks, safety auditing and iterative data flywheel contribution.

highlights.title: RLHF, DPO & GRPO Preference Ranking
highlights.text: Conducted structured side-by-side ranking of LLM-generated code and reasoning responses in Python and TypeScript using pairwise comparison and Likert-scale rubrics; preference signals fed directly into reward model training pipelines via DPO, PPO and GRPO frameworks, contributing to iterative data flywheel improvement cycles.

highlights.title: SFT Gold Standard Authoring
highlights.text: Authored thousands of high-quality SFT prompt-and-response pairs, chain-of-thought traces and scratchpad reasoning demonstrations across REST API design, distributed systems, database optimization and algorithmic problem-solving, with verified accuracy and clean pedagogical formatting.

highlights.title: Code Hallucination Detection
highlights.text: Identified hallucinated APIs, fabricated library methods, incorrect algorithmic complexity claims, race conditions and memory leak patterns in AI-generated code; produced detailed, reproducible rationales and gold-standard corrections supporting model improvement cycles.

highlights.title: Multimodal & Vision-Language Evaluation
highlights.text: Evaluated GPT-4V and Gemini Vision outputs on image-text alignment, chart comprehension, document understanding and visual question answering; annotated image-text pairs for preference ranking and factual correctness to support multimodal fine-tuning pipelines.

highlights.title: Model Safety & Bias Auditing
highlights.text: Applied Constitutional AI evaluation rubrics to assess model outputs for harmlessness, honesty and helpfulness; conducted PII redaction reviews and bias auditing across demographic and linguistic dimensions; flagged outputs violating safety guidelines with severity ratings.

highlights.title: Adversarial Prompt & Red-Team Design
highlights.text: Designed complex adversarial prompts targeting model reasoning in edge cases including concurrent programming, cryptographic implementation, SQL injection and jailbreak vulnerability patterns; documented failure modes with reproducibility steps for modeller review.

experience.summary: Specialist annotator and evaluator contributing software engineering and multilingual expertise to LLM fine-tuning, preference optimization and safety evaluation projects.

highlights.title: Instruction-Tuning & SFT Dataset Creation
highlights.text: Produced SFT instruction-response pairs and chain-of-thought demonstrations covering full-stack development, system design and data engineering, ensuring factual accuracy, logical completeness and JSONL formatting consistency for downstream fine-tuning pipelines.

highlights.title: Multilingual Evaluation — English & Swahili
highlights.text: Performed cross-lingual quality assessment of AI-generated Swahili content, evaluating fluency, cultural appropriateness and factual accuracy; authored corrective rewrites and PII redaction reviews for multilingual localization training datasets.

highlights.title: Preference Data Generation & Reward Modelling
highlights.text: Generated structured preference datasets by ranking and annotating model responses across coding and general knowledge tasks using pairwise comparison frameworks; detailed rationales informed reward model training and DPO pipeline optimization.

highlights.title: Red-Team & Safety Testing
highlights.text: Systematically probed model outputs for jailbreak vulnerabilities, unsafe content generation, biased reasoning patterns and prompt injection attacks; documented reproducible failure cases with severity ratings for safety team review.

experience.summary: Programmatic labelling and annotation specialist contributing to weakly supervised learning pipelines, NLP evaluation datasets and document annotation workflows.

highlights.title: Labelling Function Design
highlights.text: Developed and validated programmatic labelling functions for text classification, NER, relation extraction and document layout analysis, achieving high coverage and precision on evaluation benchmarks; tracked dataset versions and label provenance across pipeline iterations.

highlights.title: NLP & Document Annotation
highlights.text: Performed entity and relation annotation, textual entailment labelling, coreference resolution and document structure annotation including table detection, figure extraction and OCR correction across large English and Swahili corpora; maintained inter-annotator agreement above 92 percent.

highlights.title: Dataset QA & Schema Validation
highlights.text: Led QA sweeps of exported annotation datasets using Python scripts to detect schema errors, label drift and out-of-taxonomy values in JSON, COCO and JSONL exports; produced versioned quality reports for data engineering teams.

highlights.title: Annotation Guideline Authorship
highlights.text: Wrote annotator guidelines, decision trees and edge-case appendices for NLP and document labelling tasks; designed honeypot and calibration tasks; monitored inter-annotator agreement and coordinated targeted retraining for underperforming labellers.

experience.summary: Expert software engineering evaluator and assessment designer for LLM benchmarking, capability evaluation and open-source codebase reasoning projects.

highlights.title: LLM Benchmarking & MCQ Design
highlights.text: Designed and validated multiple-choice questions targeting LLM reasoning across software engineering, distributed systems, algorithm design and data structures; questions calibrated to distinguish genuine conceptual understanding from surface-level pattern matching and hallucinated confidence.

highlights.title: Chain-of-Thought Evaluation
highlights.text: Assessed LLM chain-of-thought and scratchpad reasoning traces for logical coherence, step completeness and factual accuracy; identified reasoning shortcuts, skipped derivation steps and plausible-sounding but incorrect conclusions.

highlights.title: Open-Source Codebase Evaluation
highlights.text: Evaluated LLM-generated responses to open-source codebase tasks including architectural recommendations, debugging strategies and refactoring approaches; produced ground-truth annotations and structured rationales against verified solutions.

highlights.title: Evaluation Rubric Design
highlights.text: Developed scoring rubrics for automated and human evaluation of LLM coding outputs covering correctness, efficiency, security posture, documentation quality and instruction-following fidelity; rubrics integrated into evaluation pipelines.

experience.summary: Specialist image, video and document annotator delivering high-accuracy labelling across industrial, autonomous systems and general-domain visual datasets.

highlights.title: Bounding Box, Polygon & Document Annotation
highlights.text: Annotated large-scale image, video and document datasets using bounding box, polygon and polyline tools across object detection, scene understanding, autonomous vehicle perception and document layout analysis; performed OCR correction and table and figure extraction on scanned document datasets.

highlights.title: Semantic & Instance Segmentation

highlights.title: Video Frame Annotation
highlights.text: Labelled individual frames across video sequences with temporal consistency checks to maintain label coherence; flagged ambiguous or uncertain frames for reviewer adjudication.

highlights.title: Keypoint, Landmark & Pose Estimation
highlights.text: Annotated human pose estimation datasets using keypoint and landmark schemas; ensured anatomical consistency and occlusion handling across diverse postures, camera angles and partial-visibility scenarios.

experience.summary: Built secure, high-performance backend services for a global banking platform; data schema design, pipeline architecture and API validation expertise directly underpins current annotation infrastructure, label schema authorship and programmatic QA scripting.

highlights.title: Schema Design & Data Pipeline Architecture
highlights.text: Designed and implemented structured data schemas and versioned API contracts consumed by millions of users in Elixir and Python; schema validation discipline and data consistency practices directly applied to annotation label schema design, JSONL and COCO export validation and dataset provenance tracking.

highlights.title: Programmatic Data Validation
highlights.text: Built automated validation pipelines to enforce data quality, detect schema drift and flag anomalous records before downstream consumption; methodology directly transferred to Python-based programmatic QA scripts used across annotation and LLM evaluation dataset releases.

highlights.title: Observability, Logging & Quality Reporting
highlights.text: Implemented advanced logging and monitoring systems to diagnose bottlenecks and surface data quality issues in distributed architectures; analytical reporting approach underpins throughput and quality metric reporting delivered to annotation platform leads and AI research teams.

highlights.title: Technical Documentation & Guideline Writing
highlights.text: Authored detailed technical specifications, API documentation and onboarding guides for engineering teams; a foundation for annotation guideline authorship, edge-case appendix writing and annotator calibration task design across subsequent AI training roles.

projects.title: RLHF Reward Model Training Dataset
projects.summary: Authored 500+ structured preference pairs across Python and TypeScript code tasks for a major LLM provider's reward model training pipeline using DPO and GRPO frameworks.
projects.detail: Structured side-by-side preference pairs spanning algorithmic problem-solving, REST API design and database optimization. Each pair carried a written rationale that fed directly into reward model training, with calibration batches shared across reviewers to measure agreement.

projects.title: LLM Technical Specification Library
projects.summary: Authored seven or more canonical technical specification documents covering incident reports, RFCs, API specs, runbooks and sprint artifacts.
projects.detail: A reference library of engineering artifacts built to serve as training and evaluation ground truth for large language models. Paired with eleven or more authoritative reference documents sourced and cleaned from industry-leading public sources, processed through a repeatable OOXML cleanup pipeline.

projects.title: Chain-of-Thought Evaluation Benchmark
projects.summary: Designed and annotated a 300-task chain-of-thought evaluation benchmark across software engineering and algorithm design domains.
projects.detail: Each task assessed reasoning trace completeness, logical coherence and step-by-step derivation accuracy, calibrated to surface reasoning shortcuts, skipped derivation steps and plausible-sounding but incorrect conclusions.

projects.title: Multimodal Vision-Language Annotation Dataset
projects.summary: Annotated 5,000+ image-text pairs for visual question answering, chart comprehension and document understanding tasks.
projects.detail: Preference-ranked GPT-4V and Gemini Vision outputs to support multimodal fine-tuning pipelines, covering image-text alignment, chart and diagram comprehension and document understanding across diverse visual domains.

projects.title: Swahili NLP Localization Dataset
projects.summary: Led creation of a 10,000-utterance Swahili instruction-tuning dataset covering conversational AI, technical support and cultural knowledge domains.
projects.detail: Native-fluent authorship and review across every batch, with PII redaction reviews and consistency checks applied throughout. Built for East African and global AI deployment contexts where cultural appropriateness matters as much as fluency.

projects.title: Adversarial Safety & Red-Team Dataset
projects.summary: Designed and executed 300+ adversarial prompts targeting safety boundaries of frontier LLMs.
projects.detail: Documented jailbreak patterns, refusal calibration gaps, prompt injection vulnerabilities and hallucination categories for model safety teams, each with severity ratings and reproducibility steps for modeller review.

projects.title: eval-harness
projects.summary: Rubric scoring, inter-annotator agreement and preference ranking for LLM evaluation — zero runtime dependencies.
projects.detail: A dependency-free Python toolkit for the measurement side of LLM evaluation: weighted rubric scoring normalised to [0,1], five agreement coefficients including Krippendorff's alpha for uneven rater coverage, and Bradley-Terry preference ranking that accounts for opponent strength.

projects.title: preference-sdk
projects.summary: Typed TypeScript toolkit for building, validating and auditing RLHF preference datasets before they reach a trainer.
projects.detail: Detects the failure modes that quietly ruin a reward model — length bias, position bias, split leakage — with a sign test, and splits datasets on a prompt hash so no prompt straddles train and test. TypeScript strict with noUncheckedIndexedAccess and exactOptionalPropertyTypes.

projects.title: annotation-gateway
projects.summary: Lease-based task distribution gateway for annotation workforces. Token-bucket rate limiting, Prometheus metrics, zero dependencies.
projects.detail: A Go HTTP gateway that hands annotation tasks out on time-limited leases so abandoned work returns to the pool, with per-annotator token-bucket rate limiting and Prometheus metrics. Standard library only — a ~10MB static binary in a scratch container.

projects.title: eval-dashboard
projects.summary: Next.js dashboard for evaluation runs: Wilson confidence intervals, two-proportion regression testing and agreement warnings.
projects.detail: A Next.js 14 dashboard that distinguishes a real regression from sampling noise. Every pass rate carries a Wilson confidence interval, run-over-run changes are gated by a two-proportion z-test, and low inter-annotator agreement is surfaced above the leaderboard. Server Components, statistics run at build time.

projects.title: jsonl-sentinel
projects.summary: Streaming schema validator for JSONL annotation exports. Constant memory, line-accurate errors, 685k records/s.
projects.detail: A Rust validator for multi-gigabyte JSONL exports that holds one line at a time: 685,000 records/s in 2.6MB of RAM, measured. Catches out-of-taxonomy labels, type drift, duplicates and schema violations with the exact line number, and exit codes a CI job can act on.

projects.title: review-queue
projects.summary: Concurrent lease-based review queue for annotation workforces. OTP supervision, ETS-backed ordered index, Bandit HTTP.
projects.detail: An Elixir/OTP review queue that serialises claims through a GenServer so no task is ever handed to two annotators, backed by an ordered ETS index for O(log n) priority dispatch. Uses Bandit rather than Cowboy after mix flagged CVE-2026-43966 in cowlib.

projects.title: redteam-cli
projects.summary: Adversarial prompt runner for LLM safety evaluation. Content-aware refusal classification and severity-weighted risk scoring.
projects.detail: A Node.js red-team runner that classifies what a model actually did — catching 'I cannot help, but here is how' as a breach via payload detection, where a grep-for-refusal harness fails. Severity-weighted risk scoring, reproducible reports, zero dependencies.

projects.title: reward-scoring-service
projects.summary: Banking-grade REST service for weighted rubric scoring of reward-model data. Spring Boot 3, Java 21, one error shape.
projects.detail: A Spring Boot 3 service that normalises weighted rubric scores onto [0,1], with domain invariants enforced in record constructors, one error envelope across every endpoint, and a batch cap that protects the worker pool. Coverage-gated in the build.

projects.title: eval-warehouse
projects.summary: dbt + DuckDB analytics warehouse for evaluation telemetry. Wilson-bounded leaderboards and two-proportion regression detection.
projects.detail: A dbt + DuckDB warehouse that turns raw annotation telemetry into Wilson-bounded leaderboards, Fleiss' kappa agreement and z-tested regression detection. The statistics live in tested SQL macros, and a canary test asserts a planted regression is still caught.
